summary_md: **Dr Cat ([@cat_dr19979](https://x.com/cat_dr19979/status/2115873915235139835))** built **drawio-reconstruction-skill**, an open Codex skill that rebuilds screenshots of diagrams as editable draw.io files, keeping text and structure editable while complex art stays as crops, with seven examples ([sxy1499894281/drawio-reconstruction-skill](https://github.com/sxy1499894281/drawio-reconstruction-skill), [diagrams.net](https://app.diagrams.net/)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - sxy1499894281/drawio-reconstruction-skill: Codex skill for reconstructing diagram images into editable Draw.io files

media.description: Examples 1–2: a decision tree and an AI agent architecture diagram, original vs. reconstructed.
Examples 3–4: a hand-drawn mechanism and a Chinese research workflow, original vs. reconstructed.
Examples 5–6: data analysis workflow and presentation diagram reconstructions.
Example 7: multi-panel research figure, plus install instructions.
